usages.explain: Expresses the feeling of "not knowing the reason, cause". Often used to explain things contrary to the speaker's will or judgment.

examples.content: さっきなぜかマイクが入らなかった。
examples.transcription: さっきなぜかまいくがはいらなかった。
examples.mean: For some reason the mic wasn't working just now.

examples.content: 私は今朝はなぜか元気がないようだ。
examples.transcription: わたしはけさはなぜかげんきがないようだ。
examples.mean: I don't seem to be feeling well this morning for some reason.

title: なぜか => somehow; for some reason; without knowing why.
